title: 第11章 老宗主来了老宗主跪了第12章 天命之子瓮中之鳖
lines: 屏风后。
顾云淡定坐着，在他的腿上，风华绝代的风云韵被他横着摆放。
此刻这个苍玄界名气极大的美女宗主，紫云宗上下无不瞻仰的存在，雍容华贵，美艳无双，新晋炼虚境巅峰的强大修士。
竟然被一个男子这么随意的放置，丝毫不敢有任何的反抗。
而男子也是丝毫不怜香惜玉，他的手掌高高举起。
风云韵的俏脸彻底染红，红的发紫，羞耻，太羞耻了！
“怎么样？刚刚不是还挺神气的吗？你身为一宗之主的魄力呢？”
顾云邪笑看着腿上佳人。
这女人脸皮薄，不想要在自己的下属面前失态，想要保持自己那雍容华贵的宗主姿态。
对此，顾云自然是满足对方。
毕竟，风云韵身上就是有一种久处于上位的雍容之感，让人心潮澎湃，这种感觉自然是要让她维持好。
虽然师尊的高贵气质更见浓厚，但是想要这般随意的摆弄，自己还是差点火候。
而风云韵就不一样了，虽然表面上雍容华贵，但是实际上在顾云的面前，比小绵羊还要柔顺。
“对不起主人，韵儿知错了。”风云韵的声音小的都快要听不见了。
“我没听清。”顾云停下手，笑眯眯开口。
“对不起……主人。”风云韵强忍着羞耻和疼痛，强撑起来，在顾云的耳边嘤咛。
“好，原谅你了。”顾云嘴角一勾，直接噙住女人樱唇开始索取起来。
风云韵猝不及防，但是反应过来后就给予热情回应。
就在这时。
忽地，门外一种恐怖的气势传入。
“谁敢在我紫云宗放肆！”
暴喝之声响彻整个大堂。
一名老者猛地闯入大堂之中，他的身后还跟着一名中年长老。
风霄看着这满目疮痍，以及一众跪在地上的长老们，怒不可遏！
他好不容易从闭关之中苏醒，本想和大家一起分享自己更进一步的喜悦，谁曾想，竟然会遇到这种事情？
“你们在做什么？”他吼道。
屏风后声音已经停止了，他不知道屏风后面有人。
“风云韵呢？宗门出了这么大的事情，她这个宗主跑到哪里去了？”
“还有那个肆意屠杀我紫云宗长老的凶徒去哪里了？我倒要看看，是哪个敢这么狂妄，真以为我紫云宗无人了不成？”
风霄冷冷开口，语气森冷，吓得全部长老都是浑身哆嗦。
这位老宗主那可是合体境的大能！
整个苍玄界都没几个这样的强者，虽然气血衰败，但是也不是他们这些炼魂、炼虚境的修士能够招惹的起的。
“宗主……在……在屏风后面。”
剩余的长老中相对资历最老的一个强忍着恐惧出声。
“屏风后面？”
风霄冷声道：“云韵，做了几年宗主你是心高气傲了？连我这个师尊的话都敢不听了！”
“宗门出了这么大的事情，全都是你这个宗主的责任，还不赶紧滚出来见我？”
说话间，合体境的磅礴气势轰然张开，吓得在场的所有修士瑟瑟发抖。
content_en:
Behind the screen.
Gu Yun sat calmly, with the unparalleled Fengyun Yun placed sideways on his lap.
At this moment, this beautiful sect master who is extremely famous in the Cangxuan Realm is admired by everyone in the Ziyun Sect. She is graceful, luxurious, and unparalleled in beauty. She is a powerful monk who has recently reached the pinnacle of the Void Refining Realm.
To be placed so casually by a man, he didn't dare to resist at all.
The man showed no mercy at all, and raised his palms high.
Fengyun Yun's pretty face was completely red, turning purple. She was ashamed, so ashamed!
"How is it? Aren't you quite impressive just now? How about your courage as the leader of a sect?"
Gu Yun looked at the beauty on his lap with an evil smile.
This woman is thin-skinned and does not want to lose her composure in front of her subordinates. She wants to maintain her graceful and noble attitude as the leader of the clan.
In this regard, Gu Yun was naturally satisfied with the other party.
After all, Fengyun Yun has a sense of grace in her body that has been in a superior position for a long time, which makes people's hearts swell. Naturally, she must maintain this feeling well.
Although the master's noble temperament has become more intense, he is still a little nervous if he wants to play with it so casually.
But Fengyun Yun was different. Although she looked graceful and luxurious on the surface, she was actually more pliable than a little sheep in front of Gu Yun.
"I'm sorry, Master, Yun'er realizes that I was wrong." Feng Yunyun's voice was so low that it was almost inaudible.
"I didn't hear clearly." Gu Yun stopped his hand and spoke with a smile.
"I'm sorry...Master." Feng Yunyun endured the shame and pain, pushed herself up, and whispered into Gu Yun's ear.
"Okay, I forgive you." Gu Yun curled up the corner of his mouth, pressed his lips to the woman's lips and began to ask for her.
Fengyun Yun was caught off guard, but responded enthusiastically after she realized what she was doing.
Just then.
Suddenly, a terrifying momentum came from outside the door.
"Who dares to act arrogant in our Ziyun Sect!"
The sound of shouting resounded throughout the entire lobby.
An old man burst into the lobby, followed by a middle-aged elder.
Feng Xiao looked at the devastation and the elders kneeling on the ground, and was furious!
He finally woke up from seclusion and wanted to share his further joy with everyone. Who would have thought that he would encounter such a thing?
"What are you doing?" he yelled.
The sound behind the screen had stopped, and he didn't know there was anyone behind the screen.
"Where is Feng Yunyun? Such a big thing happened to the sect. Where did she, the sect leader, go?"
"And where is the murderer who wantonly slaughtered the elders of my Ziyun Sect? I want to see who dares to be so arrogant and really thinks that our Ziyun Sect has no one left?"
Feng Xiao spoke coldly, with a cold tone that made all the elders tremble with fear.
This old sect leader is a powerful person in the Fusion Realm!
There are few such strong men in the entire Cangxuan Realm. Although their energy and blood have declined, they are not something that monks in the Soul Refining and Void Refining realms can offend.
"The sect leader...is...behind the screen."
The most senior one among the remaining elders suppressed his fear and spoke.
"Behind the screen?"
Feng Xiao said coldly: "Yun Yun, after how many years have you been the leader of the sect, have you become arrogant? You don't even dare to listen to my master!"
"Such a big thing happened to our sect, and it's all your responsibility as the sect leader. Why don't you get out and see me right away?"
As he spoke, the majestic aura of the Fusion Realm exploded, scaring all the monks present to tremble.
title_en: Chapter 11 The old sect master is here. The old sect master is kneeling. Chapter 12 The son of destiny is a turtle in the urn.
